suite: Installed Notepad snapshot capture and recovery

checks.name: the explicitly prepared synthetic Notepad window is foreground with one editor
only a blank or clearly marked synthetic test tab is accepted
new document captures immediately as a text snapshot without source-file linking
capture contains the full exact LF-normalized editor text, including blank content
capture retains both ends of the actual source selection
capturing creates no recovery file and requires no user-chosen save location
snapshot text, title, state and selection survive JSON persistence transport
installed Notepad confirms the new recovery document content and selection
resume identifies the actual recovery window after an explicit Notepad launch
recovery never overwrites a nonempty source editor (Notepad may reuse a blank tab)
independent native read verifies all recovered Unicode text and line breaks
independent native read verifies the restored caret and selection range
restoring a distant selected range scrolls the actual Notepad view beyond the initial page
restore creates exactly one automatically managed working copy
source editor text and selection remain unchanged; the window title may reflect the restored active tab

limitation: Actual native Notepad UI plus JSON transport. SQLite restart, hotkey/tray UX and active typing races are covered separately. No source document is saved or closed; recovery windows are left open for inspection.
